suite.allow_placeholder: One pattern per line, e.g. re:^codex[_ -] or header:X-Title=Cherry Studio
suite.clear_stats_confirm: Recent requests, per-key clients and daily counts will be cleared. Rules are kept.
suite.default_mode_hint: Off: no records, no blocking. Log only: record clients, allow all. Enforce: clients not in the list get 403 (an empty list means no restriction).
suite.default_rule_for_all: Applies to every key that uses the default.
suite.import_record_value: Imported once from {v0} at {v1}: {v2} key rules, {v3} recent requests; source files {v4}. It will not be imported again.
suite.key_mode_hint: Use default: the whole default rule applies and this key's list is ignored. Any other mode with an empty list uses the default list.
suite.label: Note
suite.login_http_note: This page is served over plain http, so the browser offers no secure key storage. By default you stay signed in only in this tab. "Remember this key" keeps it in this browser with obfuscation only, which is not strong encryption: anyone with access to this browser profile can recover it.
suite.module_not_running: The client module is not running
suite.pattern_syntax: Plain text = case-insensitive substring of User-Agent/Originator; re: = case-insensitive regex; header:Name=value = exact header match.
suite.quick_add_confirm: Add {v0} to the allow list of {v1}?
suite.quick_add_inherit_confirm: {v1} uses the default rule. Adding {v0} gives it its own rule: the current default mode and default list are copied, then {v0} is added.
suite.coming_soon_tip: This module is not available in this build yet
suite.modules_hint: Switch modules here; changes apply immediately without a restart and are stored in the extension DB (suite_meta). Precedence: config.yaml modules > switch on this page > built-in default. Modules set in config.yaml are locked; remove them from config.yaml and restart to switch them here.
suite.no_keys_near_limit: No key is above 80% of a quota window
suite.note_not_enough_data: Official usage is below the threshold; capacity = USD ÷ used % would be unstable.
suite.note_no_official_percent: No official percentage for this window.
suite.note_no_priced_usage: No priced usage in this window yet.
suite.note_window_reset: The last official reading belongs to an earlier window; the window has been rolled forward.
suite.note_no_reading_passive: Passive mode: waiting for a reading from normal traffic (no quota queries).
suite.note_fetch_failed: The official quota query failed; see the time stamp tooltip.
suite.capacity_official_tip: USD used in this window ÷ official used %.
suite.capacity_estimated_tip: Median of {v0} earlier cycle(s); not an official figure.
suite.module_off: The {v0} module is off. Turn it on under Settings → Modules.
suite.forecast_hint: Read-only. Official % comes from Codex response headers (observed at request time + time to first byte) or the official quota endpoint (at most every 10 min, manual refresh once a minute). Capacity is the median of milestone intervals (P25–P75 band); before any milestone, a rough spend ÷ used % estimate needs at least {v0}% (low confidence). Resets need consistent readings; A→B→A blips are excluded.
suite.forecast_hint_passive: Passive mode: no quota endpoint is queried; only readings from normal traffic are used. Capacity is the median of milestone intervals; before any milestone, a rough estimate needs at least {v0}%.
suite.refresh_tip: Query the official quota endpoint once (does not spend quota).
suite.ranking_hint: Read-only, from local billing events. Bars sort by the selected metric.
suite.anomalies_hint: Page badges only; nothing is sent.
suite.anomaly_key_new: {v0}: {v1} in 24 h with too few active days before
suite.reasoning_unreported: The upstream does not report reasoning tokens; this signal is skipped.
suite.monitor_hint: Read-only and passive: analyses metadata of normal requests, sends no probes and uses no quota. Grouped by account × model × effort × stream; last {v0}h vs the prior {v1} days. A group needs {v2} samples, and 2 deviating signals to be flagged.
suite.monitor_honesty: This is a heuristic hint, not proof of degradation: task changes, upstream changes or client settings can all cause deviations. Latency signals are informative only.
suite.alerts_hint: Shown on this page only; no notifications are sent. Re-evaluated at most once a minute while the page is open. History is kept for {v0} days.
suite.conf_cap_coverage_unknown: Not yet confirmed that this account is used only through CPA; confidence is capped at medium
suite.conf_cap_sampled_endpoint: Grok has only sparse samples from its quota endpoint (at most every 10 minutes); confidence is capped at medium
suite.coverage_tip_cpa_only: Every quota rise lines up with CPA requests: USD/token conversion is meaningful
suite.coverage_tip_mixed: Quota rose by ≥2 points with no CPA request in between: the account is also used elsewhere, so no USD capacity is shown
suite.coverage_tip_unknown: Fewer than 3 usable checks so far; cannot tell yet whether the account is used only through CPA
suite.note_mixed_usage: This account is also used outside CPA, so capacity from CPA spend would be too low and is not shown; the percentage is still official.
suite.band_tip: P25–P75: the middle half of the milestone interval samples
suite.capacity_milestones_tip: A milestone is the first reading at a new whole percent; spend between two milestones × 100 / point difference is one sample; the median is shown
suite.recent_basis_milestones: From milestones in the recent slice
suite.recent_basis_cumulative: Not enough recent data; cumulative average
suite.monthly_hint: CPA requests of this account per calendar month in Asia/Shanghai; cycles and average peak come from the ledger of finished cycles (kept 365 days).
suite.grok_sampled_note: Grok sends no quota headers; only cached samples from its quota endpoint (at most every 10 minutes, while this page is open) are available, so milestones are sparse and confidence is at most medium.
suite.candy_hint: Each run sends a real request to the selected upstream account and spends its quota (Codex about {v1} input tokens, Grok about {v2}). Manual only, at most one run per account every {v0} minutes, never automatic or scheduled. Test requests are excluded from billing, usage statistics and the passive monitor; the correct answer is 21. Results are only a hint.
suite.candy_no_accounts: No Codex / Grok account to test.
suite.candy_off_hint: The manual candy test is off (default). To use it, set modules: { candy_test: "on" } in the cpa-suite section of config.yaml.
suite.outdated_hint: These rules use an old preset pattern that does not match User-Agents with a space such as "Codex Desktop/0.162…", so those clients get 403. Updating only replaces these patterns; nothing else changes.
suite.outdated_confirm: Replace {v0} outdated pattern(s) with the new ones?
suite.module_switch_confirm: Switch module "{v0}" from {v1} to {v2}? Takes effect immediately.
suite.module_candy_confirm: With the candy test on, admins can manually send real upstream requests to one account (Codex ≈14,000 input tokens per run, Grok ≈300); every run still asks for confirmation. Turn it on?
suite.module_core_confirm: observe means watch-only: no blocking, scheduling or charging. Continue?
suite.mismatch_title: Clients recognised as Codex are still blocked
suite.mismatch_hint: These keys' allow lists look meant for Codex (they mention codex), yet clients recognised as the Codex family still get 403 — usually a too-narrow custom pattern (e.g. missing the space in "Codex Desktop"). Add the suggested pattern to the key's allow list.
suite.sigdetail_unstratified: Older samples have no input length; compared without input strata (recorded from 0.7 on)
suite.sigdetail_weak_persistence: Fewer than 3 usable 6-hour segments in the last 24 h; observe only
suite.sigdetail_not_persistent: The drop did not hold in at least 3 of the 6-hour segments; observe only
suite.sigdetail_partial: Only error-shaped disconnects / refusals are visible
suite.sig_group_soft: Soft signals (task-dependent; need a hard signal)
suite.observe_soft: Only shorter output / reasoning — possibly a task change, not flagged. Run a candy test to confirm.
suite.observe_hard: A hard signal deviates but output / reasoning did not drop persistently; not flagged, keep an eye on it.
suite.candy_confirm_off: Turn on the candy test module to confirm from here
suite.alert_quota7: {v0}: {v1} quota {v2} left, at the recent pace {v3} by the reset
suite.alert_usage_new: {v0} used {v1} in 24 h but has too few active days for a ratio (note only)
suite.alert_usage7: Unusual usage: {v0} {v1} in 24 h, {v2} its active-day average ({v3} active days)
suite.cooldown_tip: Until {v0} a recurrence only counts, no new alert; a higher level alerts at once
suite.alerts_info_hint: Info items are listed here only and never counted in the badge. New alerts need 2 detections; they resolve after 30 min without one.
suite.alert_locked: Set in config.yaml alerts; cannot be changed here
suite.alert_reset_body: Restore every alert setting changed on this page? Values from config.yaml are kept.
suite.alert_settings_hint: Precedence: config.yaml alerts > page > defaults. Percentages are the official remaining quota.
suite.as_usage_new_key_usd: Few active days: note at ≥ USD/24 h
suite.quota_change_tip: This cycle's capacity differs from the previous cycles (about {v0}) by more than 30 %
suite.backtest_tip: Backtest over {v0} finished cycles: predicted used % at the reset from 25 / 50 / 75 % of each window, {v1} points, mean error vs the actual peak
suite.basis_tip_cycle: This cycle has ≥ 3 milestone intervals; only its own data is used
suite.basis_tip_blend: Few samples yet; blended in log space with the previous {v0} cycles (about {v1})
suite.basis_tip_prior: No milestone interval yet; using the previous {v0} cycles (about {v1})
suite.projection_band_tip: Range between the cumulative and the recent pace
suite.projection_tip: At the pace of the last {v0} h (anchored on a milestone)
suite.pace_only_tip: The recent pace would run out early, but plenty is left (or the window just started); not a risk
suite.anomaly_key7: {v0}: {v1} in 24 h vs {v2} per active day ({v3}×, {v4} active days)
suite.conf_cap_prior: Few samples this cycle; capacity includes a prior from earlier cycles, confidence at most medium
suite.conf_cap_backtest_error: Backtest error above 30 %; confidence at most medium
suite.alert_clear_body: Delete {v0} resolved alerts and their history? Alerts still inside their re-open cooldown are kept. This cannot be undone.
suite.retention_hint: How long the suite keeps its own records. Older rows are deleted when you save, then daily. Usage and billing data are not affected.
suite.retention_reset_body: Restore the default retention days? Rows older than the defaults are deleted at once.
suite.retention_shrink_body: You shortened a retention period. Rows older than the new limit are deleted at once and cannot be restored. Continue?
